options.content:
# Honcho Tool Usage

Two independent telemetry sources are shown below: **native Hermes Honcho tools** and **raw MCP endpoint calls**.

> **Estimated payload tokens** are estimated tokens in serialized MCP/tool request and response payloads. They are **not model-provider billing tokens** and **not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption**.

## Native Hermes Honcho tools
Metrics from the Hermes plugin exporter (`hermes_honcho_tool_*`). Filter by Hermes profile and tool name.

panels.title: Native tool calls by outcome
panels.description: Per-second call rate by bounded tool name and outcome.

panels.title: Native tool duration
panels.description: p50 and p95 tool-call duration, calculated from the native duration histogram.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, tool_name) (rate(hermes_honcho_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job="hermes_honcho_tools", profile=~"$native_profile", tool_name=~"$native_tool"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tool_name) (rate(hermes_honcho_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job="hermes_honcho_tools", profile=~"$native_profile", tool_name=~"$native_tool"}[5m])))

panels.title: Native serialized payload throughput
panels.description: Serialized tool request/response payload bytes per second, grouped by tool and direction.

panels.title: Native estimated serialized payload-token throughput
panels.description: Estimated serialized tool request/response payload tokens per second. Not model-provider billing and not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name, direction, tokenizer) (rate(hermes_honcho_tool_payload_tokens_estimated_total{job="hermes_honcho_tools", profile=~"$native_profile", tool_name=~"$native_tool", tokenizer=~"$native_tokenizer"}[5m]))

options.content:
## Raw MCP endpoint calls
Metrics from the raw MCP worker (`honcho_mcp_tool_*`). These represent endpoint traffic separately from the native Hermes plugin.

panels.title: Raw MCP calls by outcome
panels.description: Per-second raw MCP endpoint-call rate by bounded tool name and outcome.

panels.title: Raw MCP call duration
panels.description: p50 and p95 raw MCP endpoint-call duration, calculated from the MCP duration histogram.

panels.title: Raw MCP serialized payload throughput
panels.description: Serialized MCP request/response payload bytes per second, grouped by endpoint tool and direction.

panels.title: Raw MCP estimated serialized payload-token throughput
panels.description: Estimated serialized MCP request/response payload tokens per second. Not model-provider billing and not downstream Honcho LLM token consumption.

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name, direction, tokenizer) (rate(honcho_mcp_tool_payload_tokens_estimated_total{job="honcho_mcp", tool_name=~"$mcp_tool", tokenizer=~"$mcp_tokenizer"}[5m]))
